text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... A placing finish, huh.
I'm glad I made it on the board, but—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco wanted to take first place
in a super cute way after all~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Standing in the center of the stage and standing out more than anyone else—that's the ideal top Umadol I'm aiming for......!
choice_data_list: You really did stand out, Falco!
Then let's make that ideal a reality.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Standing in the center of the stage and standing out more than anyone else—that's the ideal top Umadol I'm aiming for......!
choice_data_list: You really did stand out, Falco!
Then let's make that ideal a reality.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Really?
Even though I wasn't the center this time...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Does that mean Falco was so overwhelmingly cute
that I stole the spotlight from the center?!"
choice_data_list: Well, that's how it looked to me.
That's how it looked to me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~...
I see, so that's how it is~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... If Falco, who's already super popular,
takes 1st place in the races ahead—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just how much will we stand out, I wonder!
Ah, I'm just so excited, I can't stand it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I definitely intend to make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"As for what needs to be done for that...
Falco knows exactly what!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Cute, cheerful, and full speed ahead!
Training's the only way to go!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it our all together!
Yeah, let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah, as expected~!
Your voice is just as lively as Falco's☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"A training menu aimed for victory...
I'm counting on you, Trainer-san♪"
